title: The row's build action is hidden without permission or setup
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Open the asset record (from a customer) and its Inspections tab.
  3. Seed rows/users covering: a user without "Work orders - Create & Edit"; a row whose work order is ineligible; a chosen "Add lines" whose work order was since closed; a user without "Work order lines - Create & Edit"; and an organisation without ShopCoach.
custom_steps:
1. As a user without 'Work orders - Create & Edit', confirm the new-work-order target is not offered anywhere on the tab.
2. On a row whose run-on work order is ineligible, confirm only the new-work-order target is offered.
3. Choose 'Add lines' on a work order that was since closed and confirm the system explains and creates nothing.
4. As a user without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', and in an organisation without ShopCoach, confirm no build action appears on any row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Without 'Work orders - Create & Edit', the new-work-order target is not offered anywhere on the tab.
  • If the run-on work order is not an eligible build target, only the new-work-order target is offered.
  • If "Add lines" was chosen and the work order has since been closed, the system explains that and creates nothing.
  • Without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', no build action appears on any row.
  • Without ShopCoach, neither menu option is offered on any row and no build action appears on the tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9104 (S6 — Build from the asset Inspections tab); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S6; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-N1: “If the user does not have 'Work orders - Create & Edit' enabled, the new-work-order target will not be offered anywhere on this tab”
  • S6-N2: “If the work order the inspection was run on is not an eligible build target, only the new-work-order target will be offered”
  • S6-N3: “If the user chose "Add lines" and the work order has since been closed, the system will explain that and create nothing”
  • S6-N4: “If the user does not have 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' enabled, no build action will appear on any row”
  • S6-N5: “If the organisation does not have ShopCoach, neither menu option is offered on any row and no build action appears on the tab (S2-R0)”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
